rationale: eventNameFor lowercases a prop suffix, so onPointerEnter registered on 'pointerenter' while the bridge's registerHover dispatches only 'mouseenter'/'mouseleave'. registerHover still succeeded and the listener still installed, so every materialized onPointerEnter/onPointerLeave handler listened on a name nothing emits and hover feedback was silently dead; the DOM lane already bridges the two spellings in web-compat-element-events.js. The fix maps both hover spellings onto one native dispatch name and fans that dispatch out to whichever handlers are live, because the bridge's listener table is replace-only and a plain alias would drop a sibling onMouseEnter. render-assets-and-backends is crossed by packages/pulp-react only. No renderer, backend, font, asset or Skia pin changes; no fixture, snapshot or threshold moves. Registered as watch-only so the family's coverage stays honest about a change that crossed its selector. No authority moves and no Vellum artifact changes.
